title: Checks for single-line docstrings that are broken across multiple lines.
summary: PEP 257 recommends that docstrings that _can_ fit on one line should be formatted on a single line, for consistency and readability. Ruff takes this rule from pydocstyle and made it stable in v0.0.68.
message_templates: One-line docstring should fit on one line

title: Checks for docstrings on functions that are separated by one or more blank lines from the function definition.

title: Checks for docstrings on class definitions that are not preceded by a blank line.

title: Checks for class methods that are not separated from the class's docstring by a blank line.

title: Checks for docstring summary lines that are not separated from the docstring description by one blank line.
summary: PEP 257 recommends that multi-line docstrings consist of "a summary line just like a one-line docstring, followed by a blank line, followed by a more elaborate description." Ruff takes this rule from pydocstyle and made it stable in v0.0.68.

title: Checks for docstrings that are indented with tabs.

title: Checks for under-indented docstrings.
summary: PEP 257 recommends that docstrings be indented to the same level as their opening quotes. Avoid under-indenting docstrings, for consistency. Ruff takes this rule from pydocstyle and made it stable in v0.0.75.

title: Checks for over-indented docstrings.
summary: PEP 257 recommends that docstrings be indented to the same level as their opening quotes. Avoid over-indenting docstrings, for consistency. Ruff takes this rule from pydocstyle and made it stable in v0.0.75.

title: Checks for multi-line docstrings whose closing quotes are not on their own line.
summary: PEP 257 recommends that the closing quotes of a multi-line docstring be on their own line, for consistency and compatibility with documentation tools that may need to parse the docstring. Ruff takes this rule from pydocstyle and made it stable in v0.0.68.
